# ADR NNNN: <title — a decision, not a topic>

**Status:** proposed | accepted | superseded by ADR-NNNN | deprecated

## Context

What forces are at play — technical, business, or otherwise. State the problem and the
constraints as they actually are, not the solution. A reader with no other context
should understand why a decision was needed at all.

## Decision

The change being proposed or made, stated plainly and in the active voice: "We will …",
not "It was decided that …".

## Consequences

What becomes easier or harder as a result. Include the honest downsides and the
alternatives considered, not just the upside — a decision without trade-offs wasn't a
decision.
